title: Tale of Mahmud the Persian and the Kurd Sharper

keywords: tale of mahmud the persian and the kurd sharper
full_text:
Mahmud, an affluent merchant of Isfahan, was traveling through the rugged mountains of Kurdistan with a caravan of fine saffron and silks. As dusk descended over the snowy passes, he pitched his tent near a mountain spring.

A wandering traveler wrapped in a coarse sheepskin cloak approached the campfire, begging for warmth. Mahmud welcomed him warmly, offered him a seat upon a woolen rug, and served him roasted lamb, dried figs, and steaming tea.

The traveler was a notorious mountain sharper who had intended to scout the camp and signal his comrades to plunder the pack-mules. Yet, as he watched Mahmud serving him with genuine courtesy and respectful affection, the sharper felt a sudden pang of shame.

'Noble merchant,' said the guest, 'thou treatest me like a brother, yet thou knowest not my name or business. What if I were a thief sent to betray thee?'
Mahmud smiled with tranquil faith:
'Our holy traditions teach that every guest is sent by heaven, and hospitality is a debt we pay to our shared humanity. If thou comest as a friend, my bread is thine; if thou comest with evil intent, may the bread we share be an oath between our souls.'

The sharper lowered his eyes. He stood up, cast aside a concealed dagger, and confessed:
'Master Mahmud, I came to rob thee. My band waits in the ravine above to ambush thy caravan at midnight. But thy kindness has disarmed my heart. No man can eat salt at another's table and then shed his blood.'

The sharper led Mahmud and his caravan along a secret, safe highland trail that bypassed the bandit ambush completely, guiding them safely to the plains of Hamadan.
Mahmud rewarded the man with three bags of saffron and seed money to open an honest mountain inn. The former sharper became a faithful guide and protector of travelers, proving that generous charity possesses a power greater than steel.
moral: Generous hospitality offered in good faith conquers malice, turning even a cheat into an honorable ally.
